create_subtask_environment: create a SubTaskEnvironment adapter wrapping a composer Environment with effectors and a reset option
reset_subtask_environment: reset the SubTaskEnvironment to get a FIRST timestep by running the reset option to completion
step_subtask_environment: step the SubTaskEnvironment with a numpy action array and return the external timestep
add_observer_to_subtask_env: add a SubTaskObserver to the SubTaskEnvironment to monitor parent and agent timesteps during stepping
close_subtask_environment: close the SubTaskEnvironment to clean up effectors, sensors, and registered teardown callables
